## A timed slide {timing="20"}

This slide has **20 seconds**. Open the speaker view with <kbd>S</kbd>: the countdown is under the clock, and turns red at 0:00.

::: {.notes}
These notes show in the speaker view, and on the iPhone remote.
:::

## Two steps {timing="0:40"}

With the remotes, the first **Next** shows the next step…

::: {.fragment}
…and the second goes to the next slide. The iPhone and the watch show one dot per step.
:::

## An untimed slide

No `timing` here: the speaker view shows the time spent on this slide instead of a countdown.

## Pause and reset {timing="15"}

<kbd>P</kbd> pauses the countdown, <kbd>R</kbd> resets the clocks. [Back to the website](index.html){target="_top"}

::: {.notes}
In a rehearsal, P is handy to stop the clock while you think.
:::
